-- Migration: add customer loyalty level and backfill it from legacy_code.
-- Mapping is taken from codes.csv:
--   A -> gold
--   B -> silver
--   C -> bronze

ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
    WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
    WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
    WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
    ELSE NULL
END
WHERE legacy_code IS NOT NULL;
